_doc: Which models /oc may use (agent/oc_pick.py). The owner edits this file; nothing auto-merges it. A model id is provider/model. Free ids run with no key at all. Any other id is paid: it runs only while allow_paid is true, with OPENCODE_API_KEY, whose providers (connected on the OpenCode Console) are billed. Set spend limits at each provider and on the Console: this file cannot cap spend.
